items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: there was a guy lived up above me, by the name of Joe Klute... he was trying to show me how to hold my fingers

ctx.x: And when you got it home, did you spend a lot of time?

I sure did. When I brought that bass home, I was still working at the foundry, working on the night shift. Work from 4 to 11, right; so I got off and got home about midnight. And I would go into our extra, we had an extra room in the house, and close the doors. And go into that room. I couldn't wait 'til I got home.

When I got off work at night at the foundry, and took a shower, I was always in the car waiting to leave. (You know, you can get a load and ride together for work) And I couldn't wait to get home.…
